_comment: Applied to every non-archived repo in the org by apply-rulesets.yml, checked hourly by ruleset-drift.yml (scripts/check-repo-merge-settings-drift.sh). squash_merge_commit_title=PR_TITLE makes the squash commit subject the PR title, which pr-title-lint governs; COMMIT_OR_PR_TITLE let a one-commit PR land its unlinted commit subject on main, where release-please reads it (hosted#264). The message half stays COMMIT_MESSAGES so BREAKING CHANGE footers and Co-Authored-By trailers in commits survive the squash (AGENTS.md).
